extDescription.message: Solves Skeleton Casino work tickets automatically.

statusNoEnergy.message: Out of energy, waiting for it to refill.

statusNoSolver.message: Unknown ticket and no AI or guessing enabled, stopped.

statusReserve.message: Not enough credits for the bet above the reserve, games stopped.

optionsGamesHint.message: The game bot plays through the casino API with your session, so the game screen does not animate and the credit balance on the page refreshes on your next click. Blackjack uses an exact strategy solver for your table upgrades. While work has energy, work goes first.

optionsReserve.message: Keep at least this many credits

optionsPlayOnScreen.message: Play on the game screen: the bot opens the game and presses its buttons, so every round animates. Slower than playing through the API.

optionsProfitHint.message: Counted from your credit balance around every round, manual play included. Credits the debt collector takes from a win count as winnings, because they pay down the loan. Work counts credits earned per ticket.

statusWheel.message: Spinning the free wheel of fortune...

optionsAutoClaim.message: Claim the daily bonus and the hourly wheel of fortune automatically, and the bailout when broke

optionsHidePanel.message: Hide the panel on the casino page (a small button in the corner brings it back)

statusBankrupt.message: Declaring personal bankruptcy, $P1$ of debt is cheaper to drop than to pay...

statusLoanCycle.message: Taking a $P1$ loan to spend and drop by bankruptcy at execution...

statusLoanTrick.message: Taking and repaying a 500 loan within the free hour (+500 achievement)...

statusLeaderboard.message: Checking leaderboards for the podium achievement...

statusCrashBet.message: Crash: bet $P1$, cash out at $P2$, expected $P3$

optionsAutoHint.message: Auto runs everything in order of value: claims the daily bonus and bailout, repays debt (8 % an hour, then 50 % of every payout), takes the one-time +500 clean-loan achievement, checks the leaderboards for the podium achievement, bets on crash only when the round history gives an expected return above the threshold, works every ticket, and gambles only for XP within the limit below: a daily loss budget, or a minimum account balance it never bets below. Every other game loses on average, so the limit defaults to 0 (off).

optionsAutoBankrupt.message: Declare personal bankruptcy in execution when it costs less than paying the debt

optionsLoanCycle.message: Take the biggest loan when dropping it by bankruptcy is expected to pay (once a week)

optionsStandup.message: Play the daily standup quests whose reward beats the expected loss of the rounds they need

optionsAchievementHunt.message: Hunt credit achievements when their reward beats the expected loss: roulette zero, crash at 10x, blackjack natural and five cards, night play, rounds played, Friday evening work and a fast answer

optionsLearnBlaze.message: Grind Blaze at the smallest bet until its recorded spins show how stars are counted (per reel or per symbol); upgrades wait for it

optionsCrashEnabled.message: Bet on crash when the history says it pays

optionsCrashKelly.message: Crash bet sizing (0.5 = half Kelly, 0 = always max)

optionsLotteryLucky.message: Feeling lucky: always buy lottery tickets, whatever they are worth

optionsXpBudget.message: Daily loss budget for XP grinding (0 = off)

optionsGrindMinBalance.message: Stop grinding below this balance (0 = off)

statusGrindingFloor.message: Grinding XP on $P1$ at $P4$ a round, balance $P2$, stops at $P3$

statusGrindPaused.message: Grinding paused after a failed round ($P1$), retrying in $P2$ min.

statusGrindHackathon.message: Holding XP grinding for the Hackathon weekend (+50 % XP from $P1$). The daily budgets left this week go into it.

statusSavingForUpgrade.message: Saving for upgrade $P1$: balance $P2$, grinding resumes above $P3$. Turn off "Save for the next upgrade" to grind now.

optionsGrindHint.message: Auto game picks the unlocked game with the lowest simulated house edge at your upgrades. XP per round is proportional to the bet, so every bet level costs the same per XP: the bet only sets how fast XP comes in and how much rides on one round. Near a limit the grinder steps down to a smaller bet, and under a daily budget it never bets more than is left of it.

optionsBuyUpgrades.message: Buy upgrades automatically when they are worth it

optionsUpgradeHint.message: Priority order: Blaze star, Skeleton team, Blaze lucky, Blaze wild, Skeleton wild, Slotingi gulas, Skeleton deploy, Slotingi crown, Roulette zeros, Blackjack ties and blackjack pay. Crash SLA is never bought: Produkce padá pays out too little per day to earn it back. Global bets (higher max bet) are never bought: XP per round grows with the bet, so a bigger bet never buys XP cheaper. Auto buys the next level of the first upgrade that is worth its price, is not maxed and is allowed at your level, as soon as it fits above the reserve; later ones wait. Skipped as not worth it: upgrades that add less than 0.5 % return per 10,000 credits (blackjack:hint/double/soft17, slotingi:mint), upgrades of a game the XP grinder would not pick even fully upgraded, and a game's upgrades when spending the price on plain XP grinding gives more XP (over 14 days of the daily budget, or down to the minimum balance). Maxing any game also pays a one-time 5000 achievement, which the check does not count. Every 10 minutes, and whenever your level or upgrades change, the whole plan is judged again; the first upgrade worth buying becomes the goal, shown in the panel under Upgrade queue. With saving on, the XP grinder leaves the goal's price untouched on top of the reserve, so work pay builds up to it, and once it is bought the next goal is bought right away if it fits too. Saving pauses past a planned bankruptcy, which would wipe the savings.

optionsModelHint.message: Every Blaze spin is recorded with its board and the server win. The check replays them through the slot model built from the client tables, shows which scatter rule reproduces the server, then simulates the payout rate for your current upgrades and for everything maxed. A few hundred spins are enough.

optionsModelEmpty.message: No spins recorded yet. Play some Blaze rounds first.

optionsModelRtpMax.message: Payout rate with lucky, wild and star all at 5: $P1$

optionsModelUndecided.message: No recorded spin tells the two rules apart yet: only about 1 spin in 110 pays differently (several stars on one reel). Until one does, the bot keeps stars counted per reel. Play more Blaze and check again.

optionsModelMismatch.message: Neither rule reproduces every spin, so the model is missing a rule. Export the spins and send them over before trusting these numbers.

optionsCaptureDebug.message: Capture raw loan, crash, shop, leaderboard and bonus responses

optionsCaptureHint.message: Keeps the last 40 responses so field names the bot guessed can be checked. They contain your game data and the logins of other players on the crash board, so share the export only where that is fine.

optionsSolver.message: When a ticket is not in the bank, ask

solver_local.message: On-device AI in Chrome (Gemini Nano, free)

solver_claude.message: Claude API (needs a key, more accurate)

optionsLocalHint.message: Chrome 138+ built-in Prompt API. Needs about 22 GB free disk and a GPU with more than 4 GB VRAM or 16 GB RAM. Free and offline, but a small model, so expect more misses on tricky output puzzles.

localState_unsupported.message: this Chrome has no Prompt API

optionsOpenRouterHint.message: Any model ID from openrouter.ai/models, for example google/gemini-2.5-flash. Models with a :free suffix cost nothing but are rate limited.

optionsLocalFlags.message: If the model is not supported or will not download: open chrome://flags, set "Enables optimization guide on device" to "Enabled BypassPerfRequirement" and "Prompt API for Gemini Nano" to "Enabled", relaunch Chrome, then press the download button again. Progress is visible at chrome://on-device-internals.

optionsApiKeyHint.message: Stored only in this browser profile (chrome.storage.local). Each unknown ticket costs one API call.

optionsGuess.message: Guess when the answer is unknown (the bank learns the right answer either way)

optionsStopAtNorm.message: Stop once the daily paid quota is done

optionsClearConfirm.message: Delete every learned answer and the stats?

optionsImportFailed.message: That file is not a valid bank export.

statusLoggedOut.message: Not logged in. Log in to the casino.

statusSessionExpired.message: The saved login for $P1$ has expired. Log in to it again.

optionsRotateAccounts.message: Switch to another saved account when this one runs out of energy

optionsRotateHint.message: An account not visited today goes first, so its daily bonus and checks run. Otherwise the account with the most energy, above 15, or, in auto mode, the richest one that can still grind XP once this one cannot. After that it returns to the home account: the one picked in the panel or the one auto mode was started on. Each switch reloads the casino tab.

optionsAccountsHint.message: Each account keeps its own profit, achievement flags and daily budgets. The answer bank and settings are shared. To add an account, press Add in the panel and log in; switch with the dropdown next to it. Do not use the casino's Log out: it also ends the saved login. To run two accounts at once, use an incognito window for the second one (allow Botter in incognito).

optionsAccountsEmpty.message: No account yet. Open the casino and log in.

optionsForgetConfirm.message: Forget the saved login for $P1$? Its profit stays.

optionsLevelsHint.message: XP each level needs and the credits paid on reaching it, recorded from every account the bot sees, to work out the pattern. The daily bonus is the client formula at a 7-day streak.

optionsLevelsEmpty.message: No level seen yet. Open the casino with the extension on.

panelXpNote.message: Loss per XP is the credits the game loses on average for one XP point, the same at every bet. The grinder plays the game with the lowest simulated edge (highlighted).

statusWaitEnergy.message: Waiting for more than $P1$ energy before working ($P2$ now).

optionsSaveForUpgrades.message: Save for the next upgrade instead of grinding its price away

shopNoGoal.message: No upgrade is worth buying right now. Checked again every 10 minutes.

shopState_starRule.message: waiting for the Blaze star rule

optionsOddsHint.message: Simulated for every game and every combination of its shop upgrades: the return to player, the share of rounds that pay more than the bet, and the share of 1,000-round sessions that end ahead. Roulette is an even-money bet, blackjack the bot's own strategy. The current account's upgrades are marked. The last column is the return on a Konec kvartálu weekend, when every round that ends ahead gets 50 % more profit until the weekend limit.
